channel.title: Ragunauth Ramsaroop Perspectives
channel.description: Practitioner perspectives on responsible mining, renewable energy, ESG, governance, government relations and institutional trust.

item.title: Transparency Before Trust Breaks: Disclosure as Operating Infrastructure in Extractive Industries
item.description: Why extractive companies should treat credible disclosure as operating infrastructure for governance, stakeholder trust and decision quality.

item.title: Grievance Mechanisms as Management Intelligence in Responsible Mining
item.description: Why mining grievance systems should operate as early-warning, accountability and management-learning infrastructure, not as complaint registers alone.

item.title: Renewable Energy in Guyana Mining: Why Solar + Storage Matters
item.description: A practitioner view of solar, battery storage and industrial resilience in Guyana mining, grounded in public energy strategy and operating evidence.

item.title: Local Content That Creates Capability, Not Just Compliance
item.description: Why local-content performance should be measured by supplier capability, skills and durable economic participation.

item.title: Why Government Relations Is Not Lobbying
item.description: A practitioner view on transactional advocacy versus durable institutional government relations.
